user_sovereignty.rule: Agents cannot transfer ownership, alter user authorization gates, or lock the user out.

agency_chat_architecture.rule: One primary agency group chat (#agency-hq) and 12 individual agent DMs must remain permanently accessible.

agent_permanence.rule: The original 12 permanent agent identities, roles, and histories cannot be deleted or replaced.

messaging_interaction_model.rule: WhatsApp-style messaging UX must be preserved: bottom input bar, chronological message stream, reactions, search.

audio_and_notification_sovereignty.rule: All audio must remain muted by default. Speech only on explicit user click. Notification quiet preferences cannot be overridden.

accessibility_baseline.rule: WCAG 2.1 AA contrast, scalable fonts, dyslexia toggles, and ADHD 5-minute task chunking must never be disabled.

data_integrity.rule: UI updates cannot modify or delete messages, memories, attachments, or SQLite operational history.

zero_dashboard_bloat.rule: Agents are prohibited from transforming the app into a 3D virtual environment or bloated multi-page dashboard.
